lede: Packing-grade, commercial and marine plywood, plus export boxes, crates and pallets, from Perumbavoor, Kerala. Made by a group manufacturing since 1986, quoted in USD, FOB Cochin to the UK port you nominate.
tldr: TL;DR: We are an Indian plywood factory, not a UK stockist — there is no British warehouse and no local stock behind this page. Packing-grade MR (IS 303), commercial and BWR panels, marine ply, film-faced shuttering, and boxes, crates and pallets. FOB Cochin in USD; you or your forwarder carry the ocean leg to the UK port you nominate. Species and country-of-harvest declarations are issued with the quote. Quote replies within one business day.
faq: What do I get buying from the factory rather than a UK importer's yard?

Factory pricing, a specification agreed in writing before the panels are pressed, and a loading plan built to the container's weight limit rather than to a merchant's pallet count. What you do not get is next-day collection — there is no British warehouse behind this page.
Do you quote FOB Cochin or CIF for UK buyers?

FOB Cochin is our default term. A CIF figure to your nominated UK port is available on request, priced against current freight. All export quotes are issued in USD, and we reply within one business day.
What face veneer should I specify for a UK buyer?

Okoume or birch rather than gurjan. European inspectors are stricter on face-veneer cosmetic defects than Middle East or African inspectors, which is what our face-veneer guide bases that recommendation on.
What origin documentation do you supply?

Species and country of harvest for the timber in the panel, faces and cores both, plus legality documentation for harvest and trade in the country of origin, issued with the quote. Much of what we press is plantation timber, rubberwood above all, which traces to plots far more readily than mixed natural-forest material.
Do plywood panels need ISPM-15 treatment for the UK?

Plywood panels are processed wood and exempt from ISPM-15, so bare sheets need no heat-treatment stamp. Solid-wood packaging is treated: we heat-treat at registered facilities and stencil the IPPC mark, country code IN, treatment code HT and the registered facility number, which is the standard for exports to the EU, the UK and most other destinations we ship to.
What are your payment terms for UK buyers?
Standard products ship against 50 percent advance with the balance before dispatch. Custom specifications are 100 percent advance. We accept bank transfer (T/T).
